order_book: Company order book position stands at INR14,424 crores as on 30th June 2026, which comprises consultancy segment of INR10,498 crores and Turnkey segment constitute of INR3,926 crores.
So if you see in the Q1 FY27, the consultancy growth rate was just 2 percentage despite a very big order backlog.
Order inflow in year during first quarter of financial year '26 -'27 stands at INR514 crores.
guidance: And are you still confident of meeting the order inflow target of INR80 billion for the fiscal?
We are very hopeful that we should be able to meet the target of INR8,000 crores.
risks: They have been -- there is a slowdown on the new projects, which they are not issuing.
So does that mean that the lumpy orders and you saw the execution delays of what is the YTD order, if I might have missed in order inflow?
focus: Sanjay Jindal: Revenue growth rate, definitely, we are targeting -- in the last year, we were having total turnover of INR3,850 crores.
This time, we are targeting at least 10% growth -- and we are keeping close watch on the progress of the projects.
Deep Sanghavi: Yes, sir, the order pipeline, which -- like which kind of projects are you targeting?
